mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, COALESCE(p.survey_status, 'NOT_STARTED') AS survey_status, COALESCE(p.categories_known, FALSE) AS categories_known, COALESCE(p.taste_known, FALSE) AS taste_known, COALESCE(p.aroma_known, FALSE) AS aroma_known, p.target_abv_percent, p.min_price_krw, p.max_price_krw, p.min_abv_percent, p.max_abv_percent FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_user_preference p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.auth_epoch = #{authEpoch}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_preference (user_id, survey_status, categories_known, taste_known, aroma_known, target_abv_percent, min_price_krw, max_price_krw, min_abv_percent, max_abv_percent) VALUES (#{userId}, #{surveyStatus}, #{categoriesKnown}, #{tasteKnown}, #{aromaKnown}, #{targetAbvPercent}, #{minPriceKrw}, #{maxPriceKrw}, #{minAbvPercent}, #{maxAbvPercent}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE survey_status = incoming.survey_status, categories_known = incoming.categories_known, taste_known = incoming.taste_known, aroma_known = incoming.aroma_known, target_abv_percent = incoming.target_abv_percent, min_price_krw = incoming.min_price_krw, max_price_krw = incoming.max_price_krw, min_abv_percent = incoming.min_abv_percent, max_abv_percent = incoming.max_abv_percent
INSERT INTO t_user_preference_value (user_id, kind, value_text) VALUES (#{userId}, #{item.kind}, #{item.value})
